title: Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps
abstract: arXiv:2608.01692v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.

translated_title: 贝克曼传输模型：从自主流到一步映射
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01692v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们提出了一种流匹配的实例化方法，该方法依赖于一个时间无关的速度场（即“自主流”），只要目标分布是奇异的（即支持在低维数据流形上），就能精确地在两个分布之间进行映射。我们还证明，与该流相关的一步生成映射是简单守恒方程的唯一解，该方程可直接用于从样本中学习映射。这些自主流和映射赋予了贝克曼运输问题中通量约束的动力学意义。它们的构建提供了一个统一框架，例如可以恢复闭式泊松流生成模型和带有二次流匹配回归损失的均衡匹配。我们展示了该理论如何纠正现有方法中的不一致性，并证明了自主流和一步映射在ImageNet 256x256上的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自主流和一步映射的流匹配新框架，将贝克曼运输问题与生成模型统一，并在ImageNet上验证了其有效性和修正现有方法的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel flow matching framework based on autonomous flows and one-step maps, unifying Beckmann's transport problem with generative models, and demonstrates its effectiveness on ImageNet while correcting inconsistencies in existing methods.
